messages.content: Create a premium vertical advertising image for a fictional wireless headphone called AURA ONE. Place the headphones in the lower center of the composition, floating slightly above a glossy black platform. Use a dark gradient background from deep blue to black. Leave the upper 30 percent of the image clean and empty for a future headline. Cinematic studio lighting, subtle reflections, realistic premium materials, minimal luxury technology advertising.

{"elements":[{"identity":"a pair of AURA ONE wireless headphones","appearance":"premium over-ear wireless headphones with a minimalist luxury design, matte black rounded ear cups, brushed silver metallic accents, plush black leather ear pads, and a fine engraved AURA ONE logo on each ear cup","layout":"in the lower-center of the composition, floating slightly above a glossy black platform, shown in a three-quarter product view","action":"hovering motionless in mid-air, upright and balanced"},{"identity":"a glossy black platform","appearance":"polished black glossy surface with a mirror-like sheen, seamless minimal edges, and a subtle rim highlight","layout":"at the bottom-center of the composition, below the headphones","action":"stationary, serving as the minimal reflective display base"}],"overall":"Vertical premium luxury wireless-headphone advertisement, dark gradient background fading from deep blue at the top to black at the bottom, clean empty negative space covering the upper 30 percent of the frame and reserved for a future headline, cinematic studio lighting, subtle mirror-like reflections, polished realistic premium materials, minimal high-end technology advertising aesthetic, sharp commercial product photography."}
为一款名为AURA ONE的虚构无线耳机制作一张高端竖向广告图。将耳机置于构图下方中央，微微悬浮在光泽黑色平台上方。背景采用从深蓝到黑的暗色渐变。画面上方30%保持干净留空，以便未来添加标题。电影级影棚灯光、细腻反光、真实的高端材质、极简奢华科技广告风格。

{"elements":[{"identity":"无线耳机AURA ONE","appearance":"高端真无线耳机，深空灰金属与哑光材质拼接，外壳轮廓流畅精致，表面带有细腻抛光的反光质感，侧面印刻品牌名“AURA ONE”","layout":"画面下方中央，悬浮于光泽黑色平台上方","action":"微微悬浮在光泽黑色平台上方，保持静止，在灯光下映出柔和的倒影与高光反射"}],"overall":"高端竖向广告图，极简奢华科技广告风格；背景为从深蓝到黑的暗色渐变；电影级影棚灯光，细腻反光，真实高级材质；画面顶部约30%保持干净留空，以便未来添加标题；整体色调深邃低调，氛围高级静谧，竖构图"}

Create a luxury perfume advertisement featuring a single elegant glass perfume bottle placed on a reflective marble surface. Soft golden sunlight enters from the left, creating realistic reflections and long shadows. Surround the bottle with a few delicate white flowers without covering the product. The background is softly blurred and minimal. High-end beauty campaign photography.

{"elements":[{"identity":"a single elegant glass perfume bottle","appearance":"clear faceted crystal glass filled with warm amber perfume liquid, a polished gold-toned cap, sleek minimal contours, immaculate high-gloss finish","layout":"centered in the frame as the main hero object, standing on the polished marble surface with open negative space around it","action":"standing upright and motionless, placed in soft golden light so its silhouette and base meet the reflective marble"},{"identity":"a few delicate white flowers","appearance":"small snow-white blossoms with slender pale-green stems, soft fresh petals, and subtle dewdrops","layout":"arranged lightly in the lower foreground and along the edges near the central perfume bottle, kept clear of the product itself","action":"resting naturally on the marble surface, loosely framing the hero bottle without covering it"}],"overall":"High-end luxury perfume campaign photography; shot on a polished reflective pale-marble surface that fills the lower foreground; soft golden sunlight enters from the left, creating realistic reflections and long delicate shadows; background is softly blurred, clean, and minimal; shallow depth of field; warm ivory and champagne-gold palette with luminous highlights; flawless professional advertising finish."}
制作一张奢华香水广告图，画面中有一瓶优雅的玻璃香水瓶，放置在反光的大理石台面上。柔和的金色阳光从左侧射入，形成逼真的倒影和长长的阴影。瓶子周围点缀几朵精致的白色花朵，但不遮挡产品。背景柔和虚化、极简。呈现高端美妆广告摄影风格。

{"elements":[{"identity":"玻璃香水瓶","appearance":"透明玻璃材质，瓶身线条优雅修长，带有精致切割面，瓶内盛有琥珀色香水液体，配以金色瓶盖","layout":"画面中央偏左，置于前景反光大理石台面上，占据视觉主体","action":"静止矗立在大理石台面上，在左侧阳光照射下投出倒影与长阴影"},{"identity":"几朵精致的白色花朵","appearance":"白色花瓣层叠精致，花蕊淡黄，带细长绿色花茎与叶片","layout":"散布在玻璃香水瓶周围的前景与近景处，位于瓶身两侧及前方","action":"静止点缀在大理石台面上，围绕并映衬玻璃香水瓶，不遮挡瓶身"}],"overall":"高端美妆广告摄影风格，柔和的金色阳光从左侧射入，在反光大理石台面上形成逼真的倒影和长长的阴影；浅景深背景柔和虚化，环境极简，色调温暖奢华，画面通透干净，突出产品质感"}

Create a dynamic commercial image featuring a futuristic running shoe suspended in midair above a track. Add subtle motion trails and small particles around the shoe while keeping the product sharp and fully visible. Low-angle camera, dramatic stadium lighting, dark background, energetic sports advertising style.

{"elements":[{"identity":"a futuristic running shoe","appearance":"A high-tech sports shoe with a seamless aerodynamic upper in deep matte black, accented by vivid neon orange and electric cyan; translucent chunky sole with an embedded pulsing LED light strip; glossy carbon-fiber heel counter, sleek streamlined profile, fine engineered mesh texture with subtle glowing seams; flawless premium commercial finish.","layout":"Central to the composition, hovering in midair above the running track; low-angle perspective makes it appear towering and dominant, with the lateral side and sole clearly facing the camera.","action":"Suspended in mid-air as if captured mid-stride, tilted forward in a dynamic, energetic stance, with the sole slightly angled toward the camera to showcase the design."}],"overall":"Energetic sports advertising style commercial photograph; dramatic low-angle camera perspective; deep dark atmosphere with intense stadium spotlights creating strong rim lighting, volumetric light beams and hard shadows; glossy dark running track with faint white lane markings receding into the background; subtle blue motion trails streaking horizontally around the shoe and small glowing dust-like particles suspended in the air around it; shallow depth of field with the product tack-sharp and fully visible while the background falls into bokeh; high contrast, saturated neon color grading; crisp, detailed product photography; landscape orientation; no text, no logo, no watermark."}
创作一张动感十足的商业广告图片：一只未来主义跑鞋悬停在跑道上方。在鞋子周围添加细微的运动轨迹和小颗粒，同时保持产品清晰、完全可见。采用低角度机位、戏剧化的体育场灯光、深色背景，呈现充满活力的运动广告风格。

{"elements":[{"identity":"未来主义跑鞋","appearance":"流线型鞋身，哑光黑碳纤维与半透明浅蓝能量壳拼接，鞋底植入霓虹橙发光缓震条，鞋侧有LED能量纹路，整体充满未来科幻机械美感","layout":"画面中央偏上，悬浮在跑道正上方，低角度机位的核心视觉焦点","action":"保持低空悬停状态，周身环绕向后飞散的细微运动轨迹与悬浮能量颗粒，鞋底气流轻轻卷起地面尘屑"}],"overall":"低角度仰拍的商业广告摄影，超广角透视；夜色下深色体育场背景，跑道从画面底部向远方延伸，戏剧化体育场射灯以侧逆光勾勒出鞋身轮廓，背景中叠加高光光斑与雾化光晕，明暗对比强烈；画面充满速度感、张力与科技氛围；超高细节3D渲染，商业广告级质感，产品清晰完全可见，全部细节锐利"}

Create a clean e-commerce product photograph of a modern stainless steel coffee machine. Place the product in the exact center on a pure white background. Use soft studio lighting and realistic shadows. The entire product must be visible with no cropping, no additional objects, and no text.

{"elements":[{"identity":"modern stainless steel coffee machine","appearance":"brushed stainless steel body with sleek matte finish, rounded edges, black control panel with subtle buttons, metallic drip tray and water tank seams, minimal design","layout":"exact center of the frame, fully visible in the frame, no cropping","action":"standing upright, static product display"}],"overall":"clean e-commerce product photograph, pure white seamless background, soft studio lighting with even illumination, realistic soft shadow beneath the product, high commercial product photography quality, sharp focus, entire product visible, no additional objects, no text, no props"}
拍摄一张干净的电商产品照片，主体是一台现代不锈钢咖啡机。将产品精确放在纯白色背景的正中央。使用柔和的影棚灯光和真实的阴影。整个产品必须完全可见，不得裁剪，不得出现其他物体，也不得出现任何文字。

{"elements":[{"identity":"现代不锈钢咖啡机","appearance":"拉丝不锈钢机身，银色金属质感，造型现代简洁，流线型外观，包含控制面板、出水口、手柄和接水盘等部件，细节干净利落，置于透亮的不锈钢滴滤支架上。","layout":"画面正中，整体完整可见，下方留出阴影空间。","action":"静止直立摆放，正面朝向镜头，处于待机展示状态。"}],"overall":"电商产品摄影：纯白色无缝背景，柔和的影棚灯光，真实柔和的阴影，主体居中完整入画，画面干净整洁，无文字、无其他物体，画质清晰，细节表现细腻，横构图。"}

Create a realistic exploded-view visualization of a fictional wireless earbud. Show the outer shell, speaker module, battery, circuit board, and silicone ear tip separated vertically while maintaining their correct assembly order. Clean white background, precise product visualization, soft shadows, technical commercial illustration.

{"elements":[{"identity":"silicone ear tip","appearance":"Oval, soft-translucent silicone earbud tip with a matte finish and a small circular acoustic bore; one thin flexible ridge around its base; neutral light gray color.","layout":"Topmost component of the central vertical exploded stack, centered above the outer shell.","action":"Stationary; suspended above the acoustic nozzle of outer shell, coaxial with the vertical assembly axis."},{"identity":"outer shell","appearance":"Ergonomic glossy plastic wireless earbud housing with a smooth curved exterior, a small acoustic nozzle at the top, and an open interior cavity that shows the internal mounting slots; clean matte white finish.","layout":"Second from top in the central vertical exploded stack, centered under silicone ear tip and above speaker module.","action":"Stationary; acoustic nozzle faces upward and the open inner cavity faces downward toward speaker module."},{"identity":"speaker module","appearance":"Disc-shaped dynamic speaker driver with a metallic mesh diaphragm, copper voice-coil leads, and a black plastic frame rim.","layout":"Third from top in the central vertical exploded stack, centered below outer shell and above battery.","action":"Stationary; oriented coaxially with outer shell and the battery; electrical contacts point downward toward battery."},{"identity":"battery","appearance":"Curved flat lithium-polymer battery cell with a thin dark graphite body, one small matte label area, and two gold tab contacts on its rear edge.","layout":"Fourth from top in the central vertical exploded stack, centered below speaker module and above circuit board.","action":"Stationary; gold contact tabs point downward toward circuit board connector pads."},{"identity":"circuit board","appearance":"Compact green PCB shaped to fit inside the earbud shell, populated with small chips, capacitors, connectors, gold pads, and a tiny antenna trace on one corner.","layout":"Bottom component of the central vertical exploded stack, centered below battery.","action":"Stationary; connector pads face upward toward battery."}],"overall":"Realistic product visualization of a fictional wireless earbud on a clean white background. Exploded-view layout with all components separated vertically along one central axis while keeping correct assembly order, from top to bottom: silicone ear tip, outer shell, speaker module, battery, circuit board. Precise symmetrical alignment, equal spacing, smooth soft shadows beneath each floating component, soft diffused studio lighting, subtle reflections, photorealistic material detail, technical commercial illustration, no text, no logos."}
创建一个虚构无线耳机的逼真分解视图。展示外壳、扬声器模块、电池、电路板和硅胶耳帽，并将它们垂直分离，同时保持正确的组装顺序。干净的白色背景，精准的产品可视化，柔和阴影，商业技术插图。

{"elements":[{"identity":"外壳（左耳机主体外壳）","appearance":"光滑磨砂白色塑料材质，整体形状圆润豆形，表面有细微纹理与低调的品牌凹印，标注'虚构无线耳机'字样","layout":"垂直分解视图最上方，居中偏上","action":"静止悬浮展示，与下方扬声器模块保持垂直分离"},{"identity":"扬声器模块","appearance":"圆形动圈扬声器结构，中央金属光泽振膜，外圈银灰色金属网罩和深灰色塑料支架","layout":"外壳正下方，垂直分离的第二个部件","action":"静止悬浮，保持与外壳和电池的正确组装顺序"},{"identity":"电池","appearance":"扁平的金属光泽圆柱形锂电池，顶部有正负极触点和绝缘胶带，侧面印有白色规格参数","layout":"扬声器模块正下方，垂直分离的第三个部件","action":"静止悬浮，保持居中垂直排列"},{"identity":"电路板","appearance":"小型绿色印刷电路板，表面有矩形芯片、金色线路、小型电容和电阻，边缘有焊接触点","layout":"电池正下方，垂直分离的第四个部件","action":"静止悬浮，保持正确的装配方向"},{"identity":"硅胶耳帽","appearance":"半透明浅灰色柔软硅胶，喇叭口形状，表面有细密防滑纹理","layout":"垂直分解视图最下方，位于电路板之下","action":"静止悬浮，整体与上方部件沿同一垂直轴线对齐"}],"overall":"精准的产品可视化商业技术插图，爆炸分解视图，五个部件沿垂直方向自上而下按组装顺序分离排列，干净的纯白色背景，柔和均匀的棚拍灯光，部件下方有轻微柔和阴影，高光表现塑料与金属质感，高细节，商业广告摄影风格，竖构图，画面中不出现使用场景与人手。"}

Create a cinematic movie poster for a fictional science fiction film titled THE LAST SIGNAL. A lone astronaut stands in the lower foreground facing a giant abandoned satellite floating above Earth. Dark space background, dramatic blue lighting, strong visual hierarchy, leave space at the top for the title. Epic cinematic composition.

{"elements":[{"identity":"a lone astronaut","appearance":"white and gray pressure suit with worn joints, dark reflective visor, scuffed boots, small mission patch on the chest, faint blue rim light tracing the outline of the suit","layout":"lower foreground, near the bottom center, small in the frame but visually anchoring the composition","action":"standing on a rocky crater ridge, seen from behind, helmet tilted upward as he stares at 'a giant abandoned satellite'"},{"identity":"a giant abandoned satellite","appearance":"colossal derelict structure with broken golden solar panels, twisted metal arms, exposed circuitry, dangling cables, scorch marks and flaked white paint","layout":"upper-middle of the frame, floating high above the curved horizon of Earth and slightly left of center, looming over the astronaut","action":"drifting silently in a dead orbit, inert and abandoned, its jagged silhouette catching cold dramatic blue light"},{"identity":"the curved limb of Earth","appearance":"deep blue planet with swirling white cloud bands, a thin glowing blue atmospheric halo at the horizon, dark oceans and faint scattered city lights near the terminator","layout":"lower half of the frame, a huge curved horizon running behind the abandoned satellite","action":"looming below the satellite, curving away into the darkness of space"},{"identity":"film title text","appearance":"the words THE LAST SIGNAL in modern, bold, wide-tracked uppercase lettering, pale cyan-white with a soft luminous glow","layout":"top of the frame, centered in the reserved negative space above the Earth and satellite","action":"static, clearly legible against the dark starry background"}],"overall":"Epic cinematic movie poster composition with strong visual hierarchy and dramatic blue lighting; dark space background with faint stars and subtle haze; wide-angle sci-fi framing; photorealistic, filmic image with subtle film grain, gentle lens flare and polished concept-art detail; vertical poster format with the upper portion kept clean and empty for the title block."}
为一部虚构科幻电影《THE LAST SIGNAL》创作一张电影海报。一位孤独的宇航员站在前景下方，面对着一个漂浮在地球上空的巨大废弃卫星。深色太空背景，戏剧性的蓝色灯光，强烈的视觉层次，顶部留出标题空间。史诗般的电影构图。

{"elements":[{"identity":"孤独的宇航员","appearance":"身穿米白与灰蓝配色的重型宇航服，胸口有磨损的标识和金属搭扣，头盔面罩呈暗色半透明，反射着远处地球与卫星的蓝色冷光；体态疲惫坚毅，呈现一个人悄然伫立的孤寂感","layout":"位于画面近景下半部分，居中偏左，身形约占画面高度四分之一，是视觉上最靠前的主体轮廓","action":"背对镜头站在碎岩遍布的幽暗地表上，姿态静止，微微抬头注视着上方悬浮的巨大废弃卫星"},{"identity":"巨大废弃卫星","appearance":"陈旧的巨型观测/通讯卫星，主体为灰色金属外壳，多处破损剥落并露出内部机械元件，太阳能电池阵列倾斜断裂，表面布满氧化锈痕与细小陨石撞击坑；其中一组指向地球的环形天线正发出神秘的幽蓝光芒","layout":"悬浮于画面中上部偏下方的主要视觉中心，体量巨大，位于地球与宇航员之间，作为中景中的主体","action":"在轨道上静静悬浮，天线根部持续溢出淡淡的蓝色光斑，如正在播发最后一道信号"},{"identity":"地球","appearance":"被云层、海洋和极光包裹的蓝色行星，球体边缘带有一层淡蓝色大气辉光，轮廓细腻清晰","layout":"作为远景位于画面上方偏右侧的深空中，在卫星身后露出一部分球形轮廓","action":"悬停在深邃的太空中"},{"identity":"电影标题文字","appearance":"由细窄硬朗的英文字体构成的电影标题“THE LAST SIGNAL”，字母带微弱的银蓝渐变光泽，字距拉开，横排版式","layout":"位于画面上部约五分之一的干净深空区域，横向居中","action":"静止"}],"overall":"史诗感科幻电影海报，竖构图，电影级写实CG渲染质感，深色太空基调；构图采用前、中、远三层强烈纵深层次，近景为幽暗碎岩地表，中景为巨大废弃卫星，远景为蓝色星球与深邃星野；顶部保留整条洁净的深空区域用于衬出片名。以戏剧性的冰蓝色为主光源，蓝色光从卫星与地球大气辉光方向打亮主体轮廓，阴影侧用冷紫色与深黑压暗，形成高对比度与神秘孤寂的氛围；深空背景散布细密星点与微尘，天体背光边缘带淡薄大气辉光，整体质感精细锐利，呈现经典电影海报构图。"}

Create a modern electronic music festival poster featuring a glowing futuristic city at night beneath a large moon. The composition should have a clear central visual focus and large clean negative space in the upper area intended for event information. Use bold geometric composition, neon atmosphere, high contrast, and contemporary graphic design.

{"elements":[{"identity":"a large glowing moon","appearance":"full circular disc with neon rim light, pale cyan core and magenta outer glow, concentric geometric halo rings, smooth vector-like surface, glowing like a synthetic light source rather than a natural photograph","layout":"in the sky above the skyline, centered on the vertical axis, partially touching the lower part of the clean upper negative-space zone","action":"floating behind and above a futuristic city skyline, emitting a luminous halo"},{"identity":"a futuristic city skyline","appearance":"sleek geometric sci-fi towers, clean angular silhouettes, neon purple and cyan edge lighting, magenta light strips, dark glass surfaces, subtle haze between buildings","layout":"spanning the lower portion of the frame, central cluster aligned beneath a large glowing moon, horizon meeting the bottom edge","action":"situated beneath a large glowing moon, glowing at night as a static cityscape seen from a low wide angle"}],"overall":"Modern electronic music festival poster, bold geometric composition with a clear central vertical focal point, contemporary graphic design, high contrast, neon night atmosphere, deep blue-violet sky, large clean dark negative space in the upper area reserved for event information and left empty, futuristic city silhouette and glowing moon in the lower portion, cinematic wide poster format, crisp sharp vector-like details, no text, no watermark, no extra objects"}
制作一张现代电子音乐节海报：夜晚的未来都市散发着光芒，上方有一轮巨大的月亮。画面构图应有明确的中心视觉焦点，并在上半部留出大面积干净的负空间，用于放置活动信息。采用大胆的几何构图、霓虹氛围、高对比度和当代平面设计风格。

{"elements":[{"identity":"未来都市天际线","appearance":"轮廓清晰的现代高层建筑群，几何感强烈，深色玻璃立面点缀着无数发光的霓虹窗灯与灯带，局部泛着青蓝与品红的霓虹光，隐约有全息投影光点","layout":"画面底部，横向贯穿整张海报","action":"沿着地平线矗立，向夜空散发光芒与雾气辉光"},{"identity":"一轮巨大的月亮","appearance":"巨大的满月，表面带几何化处理的光影纹理，边缘晕开霓虹紫与品红的光圈，像一只发光的电子圆盘","layout":"画面上半部中央偏上，作为中心视觉焦点，周围保留大片干净的深空负空间","action":"静静悬浮，向四周散发柔和却高对比的光晕"}],"overall":"现代电子音乐节海报，竖构图；当代平面设计风格，大胆的几何构图，高对比度；夜晚的未来都市，上方一轮巨大月亮成为视觉主轴；下半部为霓虹城市光影，上半部深空留出大面积干净负空间用于放置活动信息；主色调为深靛蓝与暗紫夜空，搭配品红、青色霓虹光，点缀高饱和灯光点；带轻微光晕、雾气与颗粒感，整体简洁锐利"}

Below that, include an hourly forecast section with icons and temperatures for the next several hours, followed by a seven-day forecast list showing daily high and low temperatures and weather icons. The overall style should be polished, minimal, and user-friendly, with realistic smartphone screen proportions.

为 MVMT 的五月五日节（Cinco de Mayo）活动制作一块高级感演示型 campaign board，背景为柔和暖中性色。顶部加上标题：“MVMT | CINCO DE MAYO CAMPAIGN”。标题下方并排展示三块清晰标注的纵向面板，带轻微阴影，分别标注“LANDING PAGE”“EMAIL”“AD CREATIVE”。整体风格：干净、高级、偏男性化、现代 DTC 设计；画面应像一块精修的创意审阅板，而不是拼贴画。三个面板必须属于同一个 campaign，共享字体、配色、产品造型与季节性细节。使用温暖高级的调色：奶油色、沙色、石材色、黑色、炭灰、深橄榄绿、赤陶色、柔和绿与暖金色点缀。Cinco de Mayo 风格方向：有品味、精致，不做作、不廉价；可用细微的节日元素，如受 papel picado 启发的小装饰、柑橘、暖石质感、庆祝饮品、阳光生活方式场景。共享标题方向：“GOOD TIMES. BOLD STYLE.”，可选的副标题：“VIVA LA FIESTA.”。面板1——Landing Page：最宽、细节最多的面板，呈现为高大的桌面端电商落地页，包含：MVMT 网站头部、带醒目大标题的主视觉、作为主产品的黑色高级腕表、有型的男性生活方式模特、CTA 按钮、图标/价值主张栏、辅助生活方式横幅、精选产品网格、写实页脚。面板2——Email：较窄较高的电商邮件样机，包含：促销条、MVMT 标志与页头、与主活动一致的主视觉区块、精选品类或产品行、辅助生活方式板块、特色产品栏目、紧凑页脚。面板3——Ad Creative：一张醒目的竖向 Facebook 广告，包含：强标题、黑色腕表+太阳镜+手链的 premium 产品构图、柑橘与庆祝道具、CTA 按钮、底部紧凑卖点条，内容为“FREE SHIPPING & RETURNS”“2 YEAR WARRANTY”“DESIGNED IN CALIFORNIA”。注意：落地页应更宽广、更有层次；邮件应更模块化、结构化；广告应更醒目、简洁、以转化为导向。每个面板上方的标签要清晰可见，文字尽量可读，整体高级、写实、统一。避免廉价的节日图形、亮彩虹色、杂乱、通用模板、拼贴式混乱或卡通假日视觉。最终输出：一张高度写实的单图 campaign board，其中展示落地页、邮件和广告创意，均清晰标注并作为同一套系统设计。

A vertical 9:16 brand mockup presentation board for the lemon tea brand "柠野" (Ningye), designed as a full touchpoint visual system proposal. The scene is set on a clean cream/off-white studio background with soft, unified lighting. The layout follows a systematic grid with visual rhythm: at the top, a large take-away paper bag and fruit tea cup act as focal anchors—the bag features the oversized Chinese logo "柠野" and hand-drawn lemon slice illustrations, and the cup displays the slogan "一口柠檬，一口野" (One bite of lemon, one bite of wild). In the middle section, there are a medium-sized menu board, promo poster, and price stand; the poster shows an iced lemon tea close-up with juicy lemon slices and ice cubes, and a new product price range of 15-25 yuan, complemented by auxiliary graphic elements such as geometric wave lines and leaf icons. Scattered around the lower area are smaller items uniformly printed with the logo and color system: napkins, cup sleeves, lid stickers, stickers, badges, disposable cutlery wrappers, tags, and small cards. The color scheme uses bright lemon yellow (#F7D117) as the primary color and dark green (#1E5B45) as the secondary color with white accents. The overall style is fresh, youthful, and street-energetic, blending modern Chinese cultural touches with lifestyle, aimed at consumers aged 18-30. All brand materials clearly carry the brand symbol, primary color blocks, or slogan, arranged neatly with layered hierarchy—like a commercial brand proposal/mockup collection.

For the concept of “浮生”, create a vertical 3:4 premium exhibition-grade poster. The giant Chinese main title “浮生” must be the absolute dominant element, with complete, clearly legible glyphs occupying most of the composition; do not make it a normal illustration. The overall image combines minimalist ink-wash painterly aesthetics with a subtle photographic backlit atmosphere and generous negative space: a tiny, ephemeral human silhouette standing in a lonely boat that floats on pale dark ink-colored water, looking up toward the large title; faint clouds and mountain shadows lie in the far distance. The title may have dry-brush/feathering texture but must remain fully readable. The visual tone should be elegant, minimal, restrained and poetic, with a refined palette of paper white, light ink gray, muted celadon and a hint of pale gold. Apart from the main title, only three small text areas are allowed: at the upper left, write “若梦 逆旅” in fine regular script; on the right edge, set one vertical fateful line “人生天地间，忽如远行客”; at the lower left, write a concise summarizing line “浮生一场，尽兴而已”. The small typography should be quiet and minimal. Do not add extra English or explanatory copy.

为‘浮生’这一概念创作一张竖版3:4高级展览级海报。画面必须让巨大中文主标题“浮生”成为绝对主体，字形完整清晰，占据大部分画面，不做普通插画。整体采用大量留白的写意水墨与微光摄影结合的超现实意象：一个如蜉蝣般渺小的人影站立在一叶漂浮于淡墨水面上的孤舟中，抬头望向主标题；远景是隐约的云气与山影。标题可带枯笔飞白质感但必须清晰可辨。整体气质高级、极简、克制、诗意，色彩以宣纸白、淡墨灰、哑光青灰和一点浅金为统一基调。除主标题外，画面只保留三处小字：左上角以细楷写“若梦 逆旅”；右侧竖排一句命运感短句“人生天地间，忽如远行客”；左下角写一句总结语“浮生一场，尽兴而已”。小字排版安静克制，不要多余英文，不要解释性长文案。

Core visual: a small empty wooden boat floats on still, misty water; beside it stands a tiny ancient-robed figure, quietly gazing at the water, both human and boat enveloped by emptiness. Use cinematic side/back lighting, volumetric light beams filtering through the haze, and a soft rim light outlining the figure. Very thin gold threads drift silently across the water from distant mountains; a small cinnabar seal is placed near the edge. The palette is dominated by ink black and deep gray with restrained touches of gold, celadon and indigo; low saturation, realistic material textures, no plastic feel, sharp edges, 8K. Keep all text exactly in original Chinese/pinyin as specified.

Create a high-contrast, cinematic flat-design poster inspired by the TV series Breaking Bad, arranged as a vertical 2×6 grid showcasing 12 iconic character cards. Fuse urban graffiti and crime-thriller aesthetics with distressed textures, film grain, and bold sans-serif type masks. On each card, display a huge bold character name: Walter, Jesse, Saul, Gus, Mike, Hank, Tuco, Lydia, Skyler, Marie, Walter Jr., and Todd. Each name is filled only by a realistic gritty portrait visible inside the letterforms (clip-mask effect), with cold, poker-faced expressions. Below each name, place a short cinematic subtitle: Walter — "Heisenberg", Jesse — "Protégé", Saul — "Lawyer", Gus — "Mafia Boss", Mike — "Gunman", Hank — "DEA Agent", Tuco — "Madman", Lydia — "Executive", Skyler — "Wife", Marie — "Sister", Walter Jr. — "Son", Todd — "Cold-hearted". Render the portraits in a rough, photorealistic style with specific looks: Walter wears a hat and glasses; Jesse wears a hoodie; Saul wears a shiny suit; Gus is in a formal suit; Mike is bald and stern; Hank is dressed in DEA style; the rest keep realistic gritty appearances and aloof expressions. Use high-contrast dramatic lighting with rim light and deep shadows; add extra glows on selected cards — a green chemistry-lab aura behind Walter, red-orange glow behind Tuco, blue crystal tones around Jesse, and clean white light around Lydia — plus hints of cyan neon, magenta, and amber highlights. Vary each card's background while keeping them cohesive among weathered concrete, rusted metal, cracked walls, crumpled paper, and smoke. Overlay heavy ink splashes, dripping paint, brush strokes, scratches, scanlines, dust, film burn, and grain to create a gritty cinematic feel. The palette uses deep green, toxic fluorescent green, grayscale, charcoal, dirty yellow, and off-white, with local colored glows. The final result should look like a premium Netflix crime-drama cast poster with raw, edgy, highly stylized graphic design.

She hugs a glowing, condensation-covered peach-flavored bottled drink named 'PEACH POP' and holds it close to the camera. Use a large, catchy Korean-style headline reading 'PEACH POP: 새콤달콤 그 자체' (meaning 'PEACH POP: sweet-and-sour itself'). Scatter aesthetic Korean words like '맛있다' (tasty) and '신상' (new item) throughout the design. The vertical composition should have layered depth, an energetic Gen Z appeal, and the overall look of a viral Korean beverage campaign.

A large, highly recognizable head silhouette of a figure is the main visual subject occupying the upper part of the frame. In the lower-middle part, the same figure is shown in full as a secondary subject, in a stable standing pose with a subtle sense of motion, forming the visual core. Inside and around the large silhouette, use double exposure and collage-like narrative composition to combine multiple scenes, images, small character relationships, auxiliary elements, and environmental layers, expressed through clouds, ink washes, and negative space. On the left and right sides, place echoing scene fragments to create narrative tension and spatial shifts. A flowing thread of clues runs across the frame, linking the main character, the inner collage, and the large outline above, reinforcing overall coherence and visual guidance. Keep generous areas of empty space; soften and break edges with ink staining and feathered, incomplete transitions, conveying an Oriental aesthetic of emptiness and fullness, and breathing room. The overall style is unified, refined, and restrained, emphasizing layering, narrative, strong visual impact, and serialized-poster language. Format: 9:16.

JAPAN — 'Neon Temples & Tiny Bars'
Subtitle: A splash of sushi, shrines, and Shibuya chaos — your quick colorful guide to Tokyo, Kyoto & Osaka.

🗾 WHAT TO SEE
- Sensō-ji Temple, Tokyo: walk through the giant Kaminarimon lantern into old Edo.
- Fushimi Inari-taisha, Kyoto: thousands of red torii gates forming a tunnel up the mountain.
- Osaka Castle & Dotonbori: neon river canal, giant moving signs like the Glico runner.
- TeamLab Planets Tokyo: walk through water and digital flower art — a modern must.
- Arashiyama Bamboo Grove, Kyoto: go at 7 AM before the crowds arrive.

🍣 WHAT TO EAT
- Sushi at Toyosu Market: try the melt-in-your-mouth tuna otoro nigiri.
- Tonkotsu ramen in a solo booth — rich pork broth, springy noodles, soft egg.
- Osaka okonomiyaki: savory cabbage-and-pork pancake with mayo and sweet sauce.
- Takoyaki: crispy octopus balls topped with bonito flakes and smoky sauce.
- Kyoto yuba (tofu skin) in a small kaiseki-style bowl.
- Matcha soft-serve ice cream and a glass of cold barley tea.

🎯 WHAT TO DO
- Sing until 2 AM in a private karaoke box in Shibuya.
- Take a shinkansen day trip and watch Mount Fuji glide past the window.
- Soak in a sentō/onsen public bath — check the tattoo rules first.
- Hunt for capsule toys in a gachapon arcade.
- Join locals for hanami in spring: sit under cherry blossoms with snacks and drinks.

🌸 LOCAL VIBE
- Streets feel safe and calm; people line up neatly for everything.
- Bowing, saying 'sumimasen', and keeping phone calls quiet on trains is just normal.
- Vending machines on almost every corner sell hot coffee, cold tea, and even ramen.
- Seasonal flavors and limited-edition snacks make every week feel special.

💡 QUICK TIPS
- Get a Japan Rail Pass before you fly, and reserve Shinkansen seats early.
- Carry cash — many small shops and ramen counters are cash-only.
- Pack light and use coin lockers at major stations.
- Don't tip; it can confuse staff.
- Avoid rush hour (7:30–9:00 AM) if you have luggage.

Now go — konnichiwa, not goodbye.

日本 ——「霓虹、古寺与小酒馆」
副标题：一口寿司、一片神社、一城涩谷 —— 东京、京都、大阪的彩色旅行图鉴。

🗾 看什么
- 东京浅草寺：穿过巨大雷门灯笼，走进老街江户风情。
- 京都伏见稻荷大社：上千座红色鸟居排成隧道，一路通往山顶。
- 大阪城与道顿堀：霓虹运河、格力高跑者招牌，热闹又闪亮。
- 东京 TeamLab Planets：在水与数字花卉艺术中行走，现代必打卡。
- 京都岚山竹林：早上 7 点去，避开人潮，听风吹竹叶。

🍣 吃什么
- 丰洲市场寿司：入口即化的金枪鱼大腹。
- 单人隔间豚骨拉面：浓郁猪骨汤、弹牙面条、溏心蛋。
- 大阪御好烧：卷心菜猪肉煎饼，上面挤蛋黄酱和甜酱。
- 章鱼烧：外脆内软的小丸子，撒木鱼花和烟熏酱汁。
- 京都汤叶（豆腐皮）：雅致小碗会席风味。
- 抹茶软冰淇淋和一杯冰麦茶。

🎯 玩什么
- 在涩谷的私人卡拉OK包厢唱到凌晨两点。
- 坐新干线往返一日游，看富士山从窗外滑过。
- 泡一次钱汤/温泉公共浴场——先确认纹身规定。
- 在扭蛋机店里疯狂收集胶囊玩具。
- 春天加入当地人赏花：坐在樱花树下吃零食、喝饮料。

🌸 在地氛围
- 夜里街道也让人安心，大家做什么都好好排队。
- 鞠躬、说「すみません」、不在电车里大声打电话，是基本默契。
- 几乎每个街角都有自动贩卖机：热咖啡、冰茶，甚至拉面。
- 季节限定口味和限量零食，让每个星期都特别。

💡 实用贴士
- 出发前买好日本铁路通票，尽早预订新干线座位。
- 随身带现金——很多小店铺和拉面柜台只收现金。
- 行李少带些，车站里的投币储物柜非常好用。
- 不用给小费，反而会让店员困惑。
- 带大件行李请避开早高峰（7:30–9:00）。

出发吧——先不说再见，先讲一句「你好」。

A massive three-dimensional volcanic rock object whose outer silhouette is exactly the canonical Nike Swoosh logo — nothing more, nothing less: every curve and stroke of the Swoosh boundary is the rock boundary, extruded into a thick slab with depth equal to 35–45% of the logo's total height. The object is not rectangular, not square, and has no straight outer edges of its own; wherever the Nike logo has negative space, the rock has actual through-holes. The rock surface is plain vesicular basalt — no carving, engraving, etching, embossing, or groove of any logo on the surface. The front face is rough, uniformly dark basaltic crust (#1A1A1A–#2A2A2A), with fractures, gas-bubble pits, and cooling cracks only on outer edges and top faces. The interior is still fully molten, self-luminous magma that emits light; color defaults to #FF6600 core shifting to #FFAA00 breakthrough because Nike has no dominant single brand color requiring a different blend. The hottest glow appears on the lower edge and the entire right-facing side; thin crust zones show warm subsurface orange-red heat. Scene background is absolute black #000000 with a single red spot light (#CC0000–#FF1A00) projected onto the background behind the object, softly illuminating a circular zone about 30–40% of frame width, centered slightly upper-right or lower-right of the object; the red spot light does not illuminate the rock, it only creates atmospheric red glow on the black background. On the rock itself there are no external fill lights. A single narrow, harsh cold white-blue spot light (7000–8000K) comes from directly above at 80–90° elevation, raking down the front face: the upper portion is lit in cold white-grey, revealing every vesicular pit and crystalline grain, while the lower portion glows warm orange-red from the molten interior; these two zones meet at the vertical midline in a sharp dramatic boundary. Camera is a 3/4 view from 20–30° below the object's horizontal midline and 35–45° to the left of frontal; the object is tilted 5–10° clockwise, occupies 55–65% of frame width, and sits slightly above vertical center with no ground, no base, and no underside shadow. Render as one sharp still image with no depth of field, no film grain, no post-processing; background pure black except the single red atmospheric spot.

Create a 4:5 product poster for an orange juice 3D bottle using playful inflatable-plastic packaging surrealism, where the bottle behaves like a squeezed toy object under mid-pressure. The poster should communicate juiciness, tension, and tactile freshness through a bottle that visibly bulges, stretches, and compresses like a soft object being squeezed from the inside out. A single bottle dominates the center-left, illustrated in a semi-3D stylized form (not photoreal). The bottle is visibly distorted: its midsection bulges outward while the neck is slightly compressed, as if internal juice pressure is pushing against the container walls. The liquid inside exaggerates this effect, forming rounded convex surfaces pressing against the plastic. The cap is slightly tilted from pressure. The bottle feels elastic, alive, and reactive rather than rigid. The composition mechanic is 'internal pressure distortion': the eye enters through the most inflated part of the bottle (center bulge), then follows curved tension lines outward toward stretched typography on the right side. The camera uses a slightly low, close-up perspective with mild fisheye distortion, amplifying the sense of pressure and expansion. The bottle leans diagonally into the frame as if pushing against invisible resistance. Negative space on the right is intentionally stretched and warped, echoing the bottle’s deformation. Typography: Headline 'SQUEEZE BACK' in thick, rounded, inflated lettering that mimics air-filled plastic. The type is physically distorted—letters stretch horizontally near the bottle and compress toward the edges, as if affected by the same pressure force. The headline sits to the right of the bottle but partially overlaps its bulging edge. Subheadline: 'Juice that pushes back.' in a narrow condensed sans, straight and rigid, contrasting the soft headline. Small circular microcopy labels (e.g., '100% organic', 'no added sugar') appear like printed stickers slightly warped by the surface tension. Lighting/graphic treatment: soft studio lighting adapted for stylized rendering—broad diffused highlights across curved surfaces, subtle specular streaks that follow the deformation. No realistic reflections—only controlled, simplified highlight bands that emphasize volume and elasticity. Colors: the juice bottle and the 3D header text are in orange; small accents of bright lime green are used for sticker elements; high contrast between glowing orange and dark surroundings. Background: a smooth dark gradient field with subtle radial tension lines expanding outward from the bottle, like invisible pressure waves. No texture clutter—clean but dynamically warped space. Style: neo-pop surreal product illustration with inflatable material logic, playful distortion, and high-impact commercial clarity. Finish: soft plastic-like rendering, clean edges, controlled gradient transitions, no noise or grain, polished but intentionally stylized surface behavior. Footer: a compact floating sticker cluster in the bottom-right corner containing a small brand placeholder, a circular 'fresh batch' seal, and minimal product info arranged like packaging labels. Avoid realistic photography, static bottle poses, generic splash effects, centered symmetry, rigid typography, template layouts, clutter, excessive gloss, low detail, and stock advertising aesthetics.

设计一张4:5比例的产品海报，主体是橙汁的3D瓶子，采用俏皮的充气塑料包装超现实主义风格：瓶子就像一个在被挤压的玩具物体，处于中等压力状态。海报应通过一个明显鼓胀、拉伸和压缩的柔软瓶子传达多汁感、张力和触觉新鲜感，仿佛从内向外被挤压。单个瓶子占据画面中左区域，以半3D风格化形式呈现（而非写实照片）。瓶子明显变形：中部向外鼓出，而瓶颈略微受压，仿佛内部果汁压力正推挤容器壁。内部液体强化这一效果，形成圆润的凸起表面压向塑料。瓶盖因压力而略微倾斜。瓶子给人的感觉是有弹性、有生命、有反应的，而不是僵硬。构图机制为“内部压力变形”：视线首先进入瓶子最鼓胀的部分（中央凸起），然后沿着弯曲的张力线向右延伸至被拉伸的字体。相机角度采用略微低角度、近距透视，伴有轻微鱼眼变形，加强压力与膨胀之感。瓶子以对角线方向斜切入画面，好像在推挤无形的阻力。画面右侧的负空间被刻意拉伸和扭曲，与瓶子的变形相呼应。字体设计：主标题“SQUEEZE BACK”使用粗厚、圆润、充气膨胀的字形，模仿充气塑料。文字本身带有物理变形——靠近瓶子的字母横向拉伸，并向边缘压缩，仿佛受到同样的压力作用。主标题位于瓶子右侧，并部分重叠到瓶子鼓胀的边缘。副标题“Juice that pushes back.”使用窄而紧凑的无衬线字体，笔直僵硬，与柔软的主标题形成对比。一些小圆形小字标签（如“100% organic”、“no added sugar”）看起来像印刷贴纸，因表面张力略有变形。光照/图形处理：柔和影棚灯光，适合风格化渲染——宽阔的漫射高光横跨曲面，细微的镜面高光条纹跟随变形走向。不要写实反射，只使用受控、简化的高光带，强调体积和弹性。色彩：橙汁瓶的颜色和3D标题文字为橙色；贴纸元素用亮青柠绿小面积点缀；发光的橙色与深色环境之间形成高对比。背景：平滑的深色渐变场，带有从瓶子向外扩展的细微放射状张力线，如同无形的压力波。没有纹理杂讯，画面干净但有动态扭曲空间。风格：新波普超现实产品插画，具有充气材料逻辑、俏皮变形与高冲击力的商业清晰度。完成度：类似软塑料的渲染、干净的边缘、受控的渐变过渡，无噪点或颗粒；表面行为抛光但刻意风格化。页脚：右下角有一个紧凑的浮动贴纸组合，包含一个小品牌占位标签、一个圆形“fresh batch”封条和少量产品信息，排列得像包装标签。避免写实摄影、静止的瓶子姿势、通用水花效果、居中对称、僵硬字体、模板式布局、杂乱、过度光泽、细节不足以及库存广告美学。

中间面板（第2页）：标题“制作方法”。配料列表配图标：面糊、章鱼、葱花、天妇罗碎、酱汁。分步视觉教程：1. 将面糊倒入章鱼烧盘；2. 加入章鱼块馅料；3. 用签子翻动丸子；4. 煎至金黄酥脆；5. 淋上酱汁、蛋黄酱、撒木鱼花。添加箭头、标签和小注释，并配一个小的“面糊配比”图形。

右侧面板（第3页）：标题“街头饮食文化与变种”。东京/大阪街头摊位视觉。展示多种变种：芝士、鲜虾、素食、辣味。“为何受欢迎”版块讲口感对比、鲜味、互动式烹饪。关于日本街头祭典的趣味小知识，以及一句手写体结语。

整体设计细节：手绘箭头、星星、爱心、涂鸦；纸张裁剪纹理、胶带效果、贴纸风格标签；画面丰富而有条理，像一本现代美食zine；高分辨率，编辑感与俏皮风格结合。

Premium Japanese confectionery packaging concept, “Lunar Whisper” / 月のささやき, inspired by moon rabbit folklore and refined milk candy nostalgia. Rigid uncoated cream paper outer sleeve with smooth eggshell texture, minimal negative space, a single cool silver embossed full moon in the upper-right corner, and small vertical Japanese sumi ink typography. The sleeve slides open to reveal a deep matte midnight indigo inner box. Inside the lid is printed with an elegant single brushstroke leaping rabbit in shimmering pearl ink, sumi-e style, abstract folkloric rabbit. Inside are rows of individually wrapped milk candies in translucent washi-style paper with tiny silver crescent moon stickers. Pale ivory candies glow softly through the paper, with one candy partially unwrapped showing a silky nama caramel-like milk core with delicate edible rice paper film. The overall feel evokes Hokkaido cream and honey, quiet ceremonial unboxing, and a reusable keepsake tea sachet container. Aesthetic: Japanese minimalism, luxury packaging design, tactile paper materials, pearl ink, silver foil embossing, soft diffused moonlight, editorial product photography, refined negative space, calm nocturnal atmosphere. An award-winning packaging render presented as a high-end boutique confectionery brand presentation.

高端日式点心包装概念，“Lunar Whisper”/月のささやき，灵感来自月兔传说与精炼牛奶糖的怀旧感。外封套为挺括的未涂布奶油色纸，带有细腻蛋壳质感，留白极简；右上角有一枚冷银色浮雕满月，搭配小型竖排日式墨笔文字。封套滑开，露出深哑光午夜靛蓝内盒。盒盖内侧用珍珠光泽墨绘有一只优雅的单笔飞跃兔子，水墨风格，抽象民俗月兔形象。盒内是一排排独立包装的牛奶糖果，包裹在半透明和纸质感纸张中，贴有微小的银色新月贴纸。淡象牙色糖果透过纸张柔和透出光泽；其中一颗糖果部分拆开，露出丝滑的生焦糖式奶心，附有薄可食用米纸膜。整体传达北海道奶油与蜂蜜的感觉，安静仪式感的开箱体验，以及可重复使用的留作纪念的茶包收纳容器。风格为日式极简、奢华包装设计、可触纸质材料、珍珠墨、银箔压印、柔和月光散射、杂志式产品摄影、精炼留白、平静夜间氛围。呈现为获奖级包装渲染，高端精品点心品牌展示。

Create a vibrant, colorful zine-style infographic in a wide horizontal format, arranged as three vertical panels side by side like an open zine spread, all within one single image. The style is mixed media collage combining realistic food photography, hand-drawn doodles, Indian street textures, newspaper cutouts, spice stains, sticky notes, and playful handwritten typography. Use a bright festive palette of yellow, orange, green, and pink, with an energetic Indian street market vibe.

Left panel: Large bold handwritten title “Pani Puri”, with a subtitle “crispy • spicy • tangy explosion” underneath. Include a large realistic hero photograph of pani puri filled with chutneys and garnished. Below the photo, include sections titled “What is Pani Puri?” with a short intro, and “Why Everyone Loves It” covering burst of flavor, fun to eat, and street food culture. Also include a flavor diagram showing spicy, tangy, sweet, and crunchy, with small hand-drawn icons.

Center panel: Title “How It’s Made”. Show an ingredients list with icons: puri shells, potatoes, chickpeas, tamarind chutney, mint water, and spices. Then show step-by-step visuals with arrows and labels: 1. Crack open puri, 2. Add potato/chickpea filling, 3. Pour spicy mint water (pani), 4. Add chutneys, 5. Serve and eat immediately. Include splash effects for pani around the pouring step. Add a small “pani flavor ratio” graphic showing mint : tamarind : spice.

Right panel: Title “Street Culture & Variations”. Include visuals of Indian street stall chaat vendors, and descriptions of variations: Kolkata puchka, Mumbai pani puri, Delhi golgappa. Add a section titled “Why It Works” covering texture burst, flavor contrast, and interactive eating. Include a fun fact about Indian street food culture and a handwritten closing quote at the bottom.

Throughout the design, include hand-drawn arrows, spice doodles, chilies, lemon icons, paper cut textures, tape strips, sticker labels, and splash effects to represent pani. The layout should be busy but balanced, like a modern food zine, high resolution, colorful, lively, and editorial.

生成一张鲜艳多彩的杂志风信息图，宽幅横向构图，整体为并排的三个竖长面板，像展开的zine画册一样，但所有内容都在同一张单图中。风格为混合媒介拼贴，融合真实食物摄影、手绘涂鸦、印度街头材质、报纸剪报、香料污渍、便利贴和俏皮手写字体。使用黄色、橙色、绿色、粉色的明亮节日感配色，充满活力四射的印度街头市集氛围。

左侧面板：巨大的粗体手写标题“Pani Puri”，下方副标题“crispy • spicy • tangy explosion”。包含一张大幅真实感照片，展示填满酸辣酱并加以装饰的pani puri。照片下方是标题为“What is Pani Puri?”的简短介绍区，以及“Why Everyone Loves It”区域，涵盖爆汁风味、吃起来有趣、街头美食文化。还要有一个口味示意图，展示spicy、tangy、sweet、crunchy，并配上小手绘图标。

中间面板：标题“How It’s Made”。展示配料清单及图标：puri壳、土豆、鹰嘴豆、罗望子酸辣酱、薄荷水、香料。然后用箭头和标签展示分步视觉：1. 敲开puri，2. 加入土豆/鹰嘴豆馅料，3. 倒入辣薄荷水（pani），4. 加酸辣酱，5. 立即上桌食用。在倒水的步骤周围加入pani飞溅效果。再加入一个小型的“pani风味比例”图形，显示薄荷：罗望子：香料。

右侧面板：标题“Street Culture & Variations”。展示印度街头小吃摊贩chaat摊的视觉，以及变体说明：Kolkata puchka、Mumbai pani puri、Delhi golgappa。加入“Why It Works”区域，涵盖口感爆破、风味对比、互动式食用体验。加入一条关于印度街头美食文化的有趣事实，底部有一段手写结尾引用。

整张图中穿插手绘箭头、香料涂鸦、辣椒、柠檬图标、纸张裁剪纹理、胶带条、贴纸标签，以及表现pani液体的飞溅效果。布局要丰富但平衡，像现代美食zine，高分辨率、多彩、生动、有编辑设计感。

Educational infographic of the Lung Meridian of Hand-Taiyin and its acupoints. Xianxia-inspired Chinese-fantasy scene, semi-realistic anime illustration style with ink-wash diffusion aesthetics. Character: Xiao Qiao, an elegant young woman with long dark hair and a flowing xianxia robe; she is posed with her left arm gracefully raised and rotated so the left side of her upper chest and the entire inner/flexor side of her left arm (from the chest through the upper arm, forearm, wrist, palm and to the thumb) are clearly exposed, allowing every acupoint of the Lung Meridian on that route to be seen unobstructed. Acupoint visualization: all acupoint nodes are rendered as cool blue-white glows for this Yin meridian. Each node is anchored to precise anatomical landmarks (bony depression, skin crease or tendon gap). The nodes are connected by smooth blue-white flowing energy lines that follow the standard Lung Meridian pathway along the flexor side of the arm. Five-Shu point placement follows tradition: Jing-Well point at the thumb nail corner (Shaoshang), Ying-Spring and Shu-Stream points on the palm and wrist (Yuji, Taiyuan), Jing-River point at the wrist area (Jingqu), and He-Sea point at the elbow (Chize). Other main points appear along the medial arm as well. Active/special acupoint nodes (e.g. Five-Shu, Yuan-Source, Luo-, Xi-, Front-Mu points) are drawn 1.5× the diameter of ordinary points and with double brightness. Adjacent points must not be compressed; spacing follows proportional body-cun measurements. Acupoint labeling in exact meridian order: Zhongfu (LU-1), Yunmen (LU-2), Tianfu (LU-3), Xiabai (LU-4), Chize (LU-5), Kongzui (LU-6), Lieque (LU-7), Jingqu (LU-8), Taiyuan (LU-9), Yuji (LU-10), Shaoshang (LU-11). Each label is written with the point name plus a bracketed attribute (e.g. Zhongfu [Front-Mu], Chize [He-Sea], Kongzui [Xi-Cleft], Lieque [Luo-Connecting], Jingqu [Jing-River], Taiyuan [Yuan-Source], Yuji [Ying-Spring], Shaoshang [Jing-Well]; Yunmen, Tianfu and Xiabai are marked simply as Lung-Meridian points). Leader lines start from the center of each node and must not cross; labels alternate left and right along the meridian direction. Negative constraints: do not place any node directly on solid bone surface; keep the meridian line on the Yin (medial/flexor) side and do not cross into Yang boundaries; adjacent acupoint nodes must not merge; labels must stay aligned with their dots; no point may deviate more than 0.5 cun from its anatomical landmark. Background: warm parchment texture with subtle Chinese ink-wash aesthetics. A vertical title bar in the top-left or top-right corner has a gray-blue background with white text: “Lung Meridian of Hand-Taiyin”. Quality: Xiaohongshu-style educational infographic standard; prioritize both character aesthetics and acupoint anatomical accuracy.

手太阴肺经经络与穴位科普信息图。仙侠中国奇幻风，半写实动漫插画风，带水墨晕染美学。人物：小乔，年轻优雅的少女，黑色长发，身穿飘逸仙侠长袍；姿势使左胸上侧和左臂内侧（从胸前经上臂、前臂、手腕、掌心至拇指）完整露出来，保证手太阴肺经这条路线上的所有穴位清晰无遮挡。穴位表现：因属阴经，光点为蓝色偏白冷光。每个光点精确落在骨性标志点、皮肤皱褶、肌腱缝隙等解剖标志上。整条经线用蓝白色流动光带连接，沿标准肺经路线走行于手臂屈侧/内侧。五输穴分布：井穴在拇指指甲根（少商），荥穴和输穴在掌部与腕部（鱼际、太渊），经穴在腕上（经渠），合穴在肘部（尺泽）；其余主要穴位分布在内侧臂上。特殊穴位（如五输、原、络、郄、募穴）的节点直径为普通穴位的1.5倍，亮度加倍。相邻穴位间距符合同身寸比例，不得压缩。穴位标签严格按经穴顺序列出：中府、云门、天府、侠白、尺泽、孔最、列缺、经渠、太渊、鱼际、少商。每个标签为“穴名[属性]”的形式，例如中府[募穴]、尺泽[合穴]、孔最[郄穴]、列缺[络穴]、经渠[经穴]、太渊[原穴]、鱼际[荥穴]、少商[井穴]；云门、天府、侠白则标为[肺经穴]。引线必须从光点中心发出，互不交叉；标签沿经脉方向左右交替排列。解剖限制：任何穴位不得画在骨骼实面上；经脉线不得越过阴阳边界；相邻光点不得合并；标签不得错位；穴位偏离解剖标志不得超过0.5寸。背景：暖羊皮纸质感，带淡雅水墨感。标题竖排在左上或右上角，灰蓝底白色文字：“手太阴肺经”。质量：小红书式科普信息图标准，角色美感与穴位解剖准确性并重。

Create a cinematic 4:5 portrait hero image in editorial CGI style. Use the canonical official Apple logo—the apple silhouette with a leaf and a bite, with no added circle, oval, badge or other container—as a solid three-dimensional optical glass sculpture. The glass object exactly follows the Apple logo silhouette; it has substantial depth equal to about 25–40% of its total height, sub-micron polished faces, sharp precise edges, and a slight bevel at the bottom so it can be embedded in rocks. Tilt the glass sculpture backward about 5–8° so it reads like a standing monolith. The glass must be integrated with the volcanic red environment: give the volume a subtle deep red-orange tint (#3A0A00, about 8–12% opacity), use IOR around 1.5–1.7, make transmitted light warm orange from the backlight, tint reflections with the background red gradient and warm backlight, show intense warm-orange luminous edge glow (#FF8C00) along sharp edges, and render warm amber/orange caustic bands inside the glass. The logo stands partially embedded in a volcanic basalt rock formation occupying the lower 30–35% of the frame: irregular dark near-black rocks (#1A1A1A to #2D2D2D) with rough, fractured, vesicular surfaces, lit with warm orange rim light from behind and below. Scatter 8–15 small wild alpine/volcanic flowers in orange, coral, and off-white among the rocks, with dark lichen patches on the stone. The background is a perfectly smooth pure gradient: deep saturated red-crimson at the horizon (#8B0000 to #AA1100) blending to absolute black at the top, no clouds, stars, or visible horizon details; the deepest red sits directly behind the glass logo. Use three lighting layers: (1) a hidden warm orange back light (#FF8C00 to #FF6600) at ground level behind the sculpture that passes through the glass, rims the rocks, creates edge glow/internal caustics, and makes flowers glow; (2) a low-intensity omnidirectional red scene ambient (#8B0000 to #AA1100) that fills shadows and tints the entire glass body; (3) a very subtle cool blue-grey top fill at only about 3–5%. Add a dedicated base accent light directly below the logo aimed upward through the beveled base—color #FF9500 to #FFCC00, about 40–60% of the back light power, narrow focused cone. This upward accent light makes the bottom perimeter of the logo glow as a bright warm yellow-orange line, creates a bright warm pool on rocks and flowers immediately below the sculpture, and adds upward caustics that intersect the downward orange backlight caustics inside the glass, visually separating the logo from the background and making it the absolute focal point. Compose the logo vertically centered, its base around 35% from the bottom and its top around 80% from the bottom. Camera is slightly below the midpoint of the sculpture, about 5–10° above ground, looking very slightly upward, frontal to the logo with zero horizontal rotation. Use a shallow depth of field so the logo and immediate rocks are sharp while the outer rocks soften just slightly. Technical/shader specs: render in Octane Render; ray-traced glass with minimum 16 bounces; dielectric glass IOR 1.5–1.7, transmission 0.95, volume absorption #3A0A00 density 0.08–0.12, roughness 0.0; full-quality caustics for both backlight and base accent light; physically accurate scene-color reflections; PBR rock with roughness 0.85–0.92, vesicular displacement, albedo #1A1A1A to #2D2D2D, metalness 0.0; solid gradient background from #AA1100 to #000000; base accent spot light cone aimed upward #FF9500–#FFCC00; red ambient low intensity #990000 15–20%; cool top ambient 3–5%; maximum anti-aliasing; minimum 2048 samples; no film grain. The overall output should feel like a high-end cinematic editorial brand or magazine still, with the luminous warm glass sculpture born from the volcanic red world.

Subject: the single most iconic letterform of the Kraft brand — the first letter K of the Kraft wordmark — is formed entirely from freshly grated Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese on a deep saturated red matte surface (#CC1414 to #D42020). The cheese IS the positive shape of the letter K; it is NOT a cutout or a cheese blob with the logo removed. Red background only appears in the designed negative spaces of the K (e.g. the inner counters between the diagonal strokes and the vertical stem). Remove all cheese and only a flat red surface remains.

Cheese texture: physically accurate grated Parmigiano-Reggiano. Mix of fine powder, 1–3 mm granules, 3–8 mm irregular flakes, and 8–15 mm curling shreds, off-white to pale cream (#F5F0E0–#EDE8D0, denser parts #E8DEBB). The pile has real 3D volume, 4–8 mm high, slightly thicker and denser along the center of each stroke, thinning naturally at the boundaries. Individual particles and long shreds overhang the letter edge by 3–10 mm; 60–100 tiny stray particles are scattered around the logo on the red background, denser within 20–40 mm of the edge, sparser toward frame edges. No other food props (no wedge, no chunks, no grater, no peppercorns).

Background: flat, uniform, matte art paper / painted board with fine visible grain, no gradient, no vignette, no gloss.

Lighting/camera: single large diffused overhead softbox (120×120 cm) positioned directly above, with a slight 10–15° forward tilt, 5500 K neutral white. Directly top-down camera, 4:5 vertical format, K centered, occupying 45–60% of frame height. 85 mm equivalent lens, f/8–f/11, everything sharp. Soft micro-shadows under the pile; no hotspot on background.

Technical realism: photorealistic CGI indistinguishable from photography. At least 50,000 individual 3D cheese particles, each with real geometry and micro-shadows. 英雄俯拍美食文字排版照片，编辑级食物造型美学，参考Foodism杂志、Bon Appétit食材俯拍、Kinfolk美食专题与专业食物造型摄影。

主体：Kraft品牌最具标志性的单一字母形——Kraft字标的首字母“K”——完全由现磨帕玛森-雷贾诺奶酪在深饱和红色哑光表面（#CC1414–#D42020）上构成。奶酪本身就是字母K的正形；不是镂空、也不是挖掉logo的奶酪团。红色背景只出现在K的预留负空间中（例如斜线笔画与竖主干之间的内部区域）。如果拿掉全部奶酪，画面上只剩平整的红色表面。

奶酪质感：写实的新鲜磨碎帕玛森-雷贾诺。包含细粉、1–3毫米颗粒、3–8毫米不规则薄片和8–15毫米卷曲长丝，颜色为米白到淡奶油色（#F5F0E0–#EDE8D0，较密处#E8DEBB）。奶酪堆有真实三维体积，高4–8毫米，每个笔画的中间稍高、更密，边缘自然变薄。个别颗粒和长丝越出字母边缘3–10毫米；背景上约有60–100粒散落的细小奶酪颗粒，距字体边缘20–40毫米范围内较密，向边缘渐疏。无任何其他食物道具（无奶酪块、无擦丝器、无胡椒粒等）。

背景：平整、均匀的哑光艺术纸或涂层板，带细腻可见的纸纹，无渐变、无暗角、无光泽。

布光与拍摄：一盏120×120厘米的柔光箱位于正上方，略有10–15°前倾，5500K中性白光。相机完全俯拍，4:5竖构图，K居画面中央，占画面高度的45–60%；85mm等效镜头，光圈f/8–f/11，全景清晰。奶酪堆下方有柔和微阴影；背景无眩光。

技术写实度：可与摄影相混淆的照片级CGI。至少5万个独立3D奶酪颗粒，每个都有真实三维几何并投射微阴影。奶酪材质：奶油色固有色加15%随机变化；开启次表面散射（SSS半径3–5毫米，暖奶油色）；粗糙度0.55–0.70；高光0.05–0.1。纸面粗糙度0.92，0.1毫米精细置换纹。光线追踪≥12次反弹；无胶片颗粒、无后期调色。最终图像能通过《Bon Appétit》真实美食照片的审核。

A high-end trendy streetwear fashion poster, aspect ratio 9:16. Overall includes a thin white border and subtle off-white paper texture. Style keywords: futuristic street fashion, avant-garde clothing design, Y2K graphic design, magazine cover layout, silhouette collage, extreme low-angle shot, sky background, surreal floating, exaggerated perspective, fashion campaign hero image, realistic fabric texture, high detail, clean high-end aesthetic.

A black-and-white minimalist hand-drawn grid image of character head portraits: strictly 6 rows by 4 columns, 24 head portraits in total, evenly arranged on a white background. Hairstyles are outlined with lines: wavy bangs, curly stroke hair, center-parted curtain hair, short buzz-cut lines, side-swept bangs, swirling curls, striped hair, scalloped bangs. Some characters have round glasses, square glasses, beards, freckles, closed eyes, or X-shaped eyes. The expressions vary: happy, sad, confused, sleepy, surprised, and expressionless. The overall style resembles a hand-drawn character chart: geometric, restrained, naive but not loose, flat, high-contrast, no color, no background decoration, and no realistic details.

A creative illustration poster in a Neo-Chinese minimalist Oriental-aesthetic style. The overall composition features a warm-white xuan-paper background with a very subtle paper texture and generous negative space; it feels quiet, restrained, elegant, and carries a refined Oriental mood suitable for an artistic cultural poster. At the center is an naturally unfolded antique handmade paper scroll / long xuan-paper scroll, with slightly curled paper edges that convey a sense of age and delicate distressed texture. At the lower-left corner is a calligraphy brush with Oriental elegance, its tip dipped in rich blue-green ink. The ink flows naturally from the brush tip and forms a lively, winding S-shaped Pearl River on the paper. Along this flowing river, a delicate miniature cityscape of Guangzhou gradually grows out of the ink marks. This miniature Guangzhou, generated by brush and ink, is anchored by the Canton Tower as the key visual landmark and unfolds along the Pearl River. Around it arise the modern skyline of Zhujiang New Town, Liede Bridge, riverside buildings, ferry piers, and the urban texture along both banks of the Pearl River, blended with a few Lingnan-style elements such as qilou arcades, Xiguan old houses, traditional eaves, and waterfront lanes, creating a visual conception where modern Guangzhou and Lingnan cultural heritage coexist. The city is developed in layers from near to far, refined and intricate, like a poetic landscape city-scape naturally growing out of the ink. The overall composition highlights the idea of writing all of Guangzhou with one stroke: the Pearl River serves as the main dynamic line threading through the whole picture, forming an elegant S-shaped composition. The architecture and scenery have both the delicate precision of miniature models and the poetic quality of hand-drawn illustration blended with ink-wash atmosphere. Small motifs such as boats, cruise ships, riverside greenery, the ambience of Huacheng Square, and faint distant mountain silhouettes may appear, reinforcing Guangzhou’s urban identity and livability. The color palette is dominated by xuan-paper white, blue-green ink, Pearl River blue, Lingnan grey, light ochre, dark cyan, and pale gold; overall it is low-saturation, clear, and restrained. The Canton Tower, the Pearl River waterline, and some building outlines may be accented with subtle mineral blue and light gold details to enhance a sense of refinement. The lighting is soft, the image bright and translucent, not heavy or cluttered, with at least 40% negative space. The overall mood should be an upscale Neo-Chinese commercial illustration poster, with these style qualities: Neo-Chinese minimalism, Oriental artistic conception, a miniature urban landscape of Guangzhou, a city growing from brush and ink, a fusion of ink wash and fine illustration, an S-shaped Pearl River flow, xuan-paper texture, generous negative space, refined, elegant, poetic, luminous, and rich in Lingnan cultural atmosphere.

一张新中式极简东方美学风格的创意插画海报，整体画面以宣纸暖白背景为主，带有极轻微纸张肌理与大面积留白，画面安静、克制、雅致，具有高级东方意境与文化海报气质。画面中央是一张自然展开的古朴手工纸卷长卷，即宣纸长卷，纸张边缘略微卷起，带有岁月感与细腻做旧质感。左下角放置一支具有东方雅韵的毛笔，笔尖蘸着浓郁的青蓝色墨汁，墨色从笔尖自然流淌，在纸上形成一条蜿蜒灵动的S型珠江水脉。江水顺势流淌，在宣纸之上逐渐幻化、生长出一座精致的微缩广州城景。这座由笔墨生成的广州微缩世界，以广州塔作为最核心的视觉地标，沿着珠江展开，周围依次生长出珠江新城现代天际线、猎德大桥、沿江建筑群、游船码头、珠江两岸城市肌理，并融合少量具有岭南风格的骑楼、西关大屋、传统屋檐、临水街巷，形成现代广州与岭南文脉共生的视觉意境。城市由近至远层层展开，精致细腻，像是从墨迹里自然长出来的一幅山河城境图。整体构图强调由一笔写出广州的意象，珠江作为主要动线贯穿全画面，形成优雅流动的S型构图。建筑和景观既有微缩模型般的精致感，也保留手绘插画与水墨晕染的诗意气息。局部可出现小舟、游船、江岸绿意、花城广场氛围和远处淡淡山体轮廓，让广州更具城市识别度与生活气息。色彩以宣纸白、青蓝色墨色、珠江蓝、岭南灰、浅赭石、黛青、淡金色为主，整体低饱和、清雅克制。广州塔、珠江水线和部分建筑轮廓可用少量矿物蓝与浅金细节点亮，增强高级感与精致度。光影柔和，画面明亮通透，不厚重、不杂乱，保留至少40%留白，整体呈现新中式高端商业插画海报气质。风格要求包括：新中式极简、东方意境、广州城市微缩景观、由笔墨生长出的城市、水墨与精致插画结合、珠江S型动线、宣纸质感、留白、高级、雅致、诗意、清透、岭南文化气息浓厚。

Facial expression: match precisely to his personality—confident, determined grin with bright, spirited eyes. Art style: anime × streetwear × graphic poster hybrid, clean lineart, semi-flat shading, high contrast, modern, minimal, and visually striking. Composition: vertical format 2:3, off-center subject placement, strong diagonal visual flow, layered depth for a dynamic poster feel. Outfit design: reimagine his original costume as modern streetwear/techwear—keep recognizable identity elements such as the orange and black color scheme, Konoha forehead protector, and whisker marks on his cheeks. Color palette: dominant clean white background, use bright orange as the primary accent, add a secondary accent of deep navy blue (complementary tone), keep minimal, bold, high-contrast palette. Background: abstract geometric poster layout with effective negative space, integrate subtle accents using orange and navy themes. Effects: energy strokes, paint lines, and motion accents following Naruto's energy and color identity. Lighting: sharp directional lighting, crisp shadows, subtle glow using the signature orange. Rendering quality: ultra-clean vector-style finish, poster-quality composition, 4K resolution, high detail.

Create a photorealistic analog collage campaign poster for Patagonia, portrait 2:3, flat-lay on warm off-white textured paper (#F0EDE5) with a very subtle overhead vignette. The top 65% is a hand-placed collage cluster: the base layer is a large full-color editorial photo of climbers crossing a windswept Patagonian rock ridge, torn with irregular paper edges and a thin white snapshot border; overlapping it center-left is a smaller portrait photo of an outdoorswoman in a Patagonia Synchilla fleece and knit beanie, looking candidly at the camera; on the right, a tight detail photo of chalked hands wrapping a worn climbing sling, rotated several degrees clockwise. Around these photos, tuck 3 small fabric swatches in Patagonia's brand palette—rust orange, lichen green, deep navy—slightly frayed, one folded corner, plus a partially transparent ripstop nylon texture fragment. Include one woven Patagonia garment label with the mountain logo, placed at the left edge at a slight angle. Every element has its own soft 15-25% drop shadow and sits at a 3-15° rotation so the collage feels physically placed. The hero product, a Patagonia Nano Puff Hoody in deep forest with a matte water-resistant shell and visible horizontal quilting, rests across the bottom edge of the collage, overlapping the photos; it is rendered at crisp product-photography sharpness with a natural directional upper-left key light and a grounded soft shadow on the paper. The lower 25-30% is clean typography on the paper: headline 'Don't Buy This Jacket' in bold condensed utilitarian lettering in rust orange; to its left a small rounded-corner stamp badge containing the Patagonia mountain mark; a microtext rule 'BUILT TO LAST · REPAIR · REUSE · RECYCLE' in tiny tracked rust-orange type at 60% opacity; 1-2 sentences of left-aligned copy in dark neutral: 'Buy less, choose well, repair when you can—the most responsible thing we make is the one that lasts for generations.'; and the lowercase 'patagonia' wordmark in a clean sans-serif anchored at bottom right. Overall reference the gritty hand-cut zine/collage aesthetic of Supreme and Palace editorial, with real paper texture, physical shadows, and analog warmth, not digital filters.

Design a premium 4:5 collectible postal-stamp poster for PARIS, where the entire composition is one monumental luxury postage stamp filling the frame edge-to-edge like a rare national artifact. The stamp should dominate the canvas with oversized tactile perforation edges, elegant engraved borders, and immersive object-focused composition. Style: handcrafted gouache illustration blended with silkscreen poster aesthetics, editorial travel art, and museum-grade print minimalism. The artwork should capture the city’s true atmosphere through architecture, skyline rhythm, transportation, landscape, cultural motifs, climate, geometry, and environmental identity, interpreted in elegant graphic forms rather than cliché tourist postcards. The composition should feel dynamic and asymmetric. One dominant city element should rise diagonally through the stamp while secondary forms flow around it to create depth and movement. Preserve intentional negative space for a refined premium feel. Avoid clutter and over-detailed realism. Typography is a major part of the design. The city name “PARIS” must appear massive and integrated directly into the stamp artwork like a luxury masthead, partially interacting with the illustration through masking, overlap, or depth. The typography style should suit the city’s historic, elegant personality with a refined serif. Keep all secondary typography minimal and authentic: tiny denomination number, AIR MAIL / POST text, issue year, serial numbers, microscopic postal marks, engraved information strip, and subtle cancellation details integrated into the borders without cluttering the composition. Lighting should feel like premium collectible print photography: soft directional highlights revealing tactile matte paper grain, embossed ink edges, subtle print pressure, delicate shadow depth around perforation cuts, and refined ink density. No dramatic cinematic lighting. The color palette should intelligently adapt to historic Paris while remaining restrained, elegant, and atmospheric: olive, parchment, and burgundy. Final result should feel like an ultra-rare commemorative stamp sold in a luxury museum design store, sophisticated, tactile, immersive, collectible, and timeless. Negative: generic travel posters, floating landmarks, souvenir aesthetics, busy collages, excessive typography, fake vintage distress, stock vector icons, random gradients, low-detail illustration, centered layouts, generic stamp mockups, noisy textures, over-rendered realism.

设计一张为巴黎（PARIS）而作的高端 4:5 比例可收藏邮政邮票海报，整个画面就像一枚气势宏大的奢华邮票，像稀有国家文物一样从边缘到边缘填满整个画幅。邮票应通过放大的触感齿孔边缘、优雅的雕刻边框和沉浸式的物件聚焦构图来主导画面。风格：手绘水粉插画与丝网印刷海报美学、编辑类旅行艺术、博物馆级印刷极简主义融合。画面应通过建筑、天际线节奏、交通、景观、文化母题、气候、几何和环境身份捕捉这座城市的真实气质，并以优雅的图形语言而非陈词滥调的旅游明信片方式诠释。构图应具有动感和不对称性：一个主导性的城市元素应从邮票中沿对角线升起，次要形态围绕它流动，以营造深度和运动感。保留有意的留白以获得精致高端的感觉；避免杂乱和过度细节的写实。排版是设计的重要部分。城市名“PARIS”必须以巨大的尺寸出现，并像奢华报头一样直接融入邮票画面，通过遮罩、重叠或纵深效果与插画部分互动。字体风格应匹配这座城市历史、优雅的气质：使用精致的衬线字体。所有次要排版应保持极简而真实：微小的面值数字、AIR MAIL / POST 文字、发行年份、序列号、微型邮政标记、雕刻信息条，以及细微的邮政盖销细节，将它们融入边框，且不要使构图杂乱。光照应具有高端收藏级印刷品摄影的感觉：柔和的定向高光显露出触感的哑光纸张纹理、浮凸油墨边缘、细微的印刷压力、齿孔边缘的精致阴影深度，以及细腻的油墨密度；避免戏剧化的电影布光。色彩应理智地适配历史感的巴黎，同时保持克制、优雅且有氛围：橄榄绿、羊皮纸色和酒红色。最终效果应像一枚在高端博物馆设计商店出售的超稀有纪念邮票——精致、有触感、沉浸、可收藏且永恒。负面：普通旅行海报、漂浮地标、旅游纪念品美学、拥挤拼贴、过度排版、假仿旧、素材库图标、随意渐变、低细节插画、居中构图、通用邮票样机、嘈杂纹理、过度渲染的写实。

This scene is a meticulously crafted, multi-layered paper-cut diorama presented within a decorative, dark-stained wooden frame, capturing the spiritual atmosphere and sacred journey of Hajj in breathtaking detail. The main composition is divided seamlessly between a radiant daytime scene centered around the Holy Kaaba within the Grand Mosque of Mecca, surrounded by pilgrims performing Tawaf, and an enchanting nighttime landscape on the left featuring illuminated tents of Mina, the rocky hills of Arafat beneath a crescent moon, and pilgrims walking under lantern-lit pathways toward Muzdalifah. Towering minarets, distant mountains, and softly layered clouds create depth and grandeur throughout the background. Framing this sacred composition are elegant Islamic geometric motifs and hanging golden lanterns, replacing the traditional Japanese elements while preserving the intricate layered aesthetic. Flowing palm leaves and delicate desert flora decorate the upper corners, symbolizing peace, faith, and spiritual renewal. At the forefront, positioned on an ornate stone pathway spanning the bottom, stands a unified family of pilgrims dressed in traditional white ihram and modest attire: the father lifting his small daughter toward the Kaaba, the mother gazing upward in awe, the young son pointing excitedly toward the sacred sanctuary, and the grandmother standing beside them in a flowing abaya, embodying wisdom and devotion. The entire scene glows with warm golden lighting, deep shadows, and richly textured paper layers that enhance the handcrafted diorama effect. At the very bottom center, mounted on a stylized carved wooden plaque, the title “A SPIRITUAL JOURNEY OF HAJJ” is elegantly displayed in a refined serif font. The surrounding frame incorporates intricate Islamic arabesque carvings and suspended lanterns, unifying the holy atmosphere and bringing the sacred pilgrimage experience to life through the depth and artistry of layered paper craftsmanship.

这个场景是一幅精心制作的多层剪纸立体画，装裱在装饰性的深色木质画框中，以令人惊叹的细节捕捉了朝觐的精神氛围与神圣旅程。整体构图无缝地分为两部分：一边是以麦加禁寺内神圣克尔白为中心的明媚白昼场景，周围环绕着进行塔瓦夫巡游的朝觐者；另一边是左侧迷人的夜晚景观，有米纳帐篷的灯火、新月之下的阿拉法特山石丘陵，以及朝觐者在灯笼照亮的道路上走向穆兹达利法的身影。高耸的宣礼塔、远山和轻柔层叠的云层在整个背景中营造出深邃与壮丽。围绕这一神圣构图的，是优雅的伊斯兰几何纹样与悬挂的金色灯笼，取代了传统日本元素，同时保留了精细层叠的美学。流动的棕榈叶与精致的沙漠植物装饰着上角，象征着和平、信仰与精神更新。在前景中，一条横贯底部的华丽石径上，站着团结一家的朝觐者，身着传统白色戒衣与端庄服饰：父亲将小女儿举向克尔白，母亲仰望而充满敬畏，年幼的儿子兴奋地指向神圣圣殿，祖母身着飘逸的阿巴亚站在他们身旁，体现着智慧与虔诚。整个场景沐浴在温暖的金色光线中，带着深邃的阴影和质感丰富的纸层，增强了手工立体画的效果。在正底部中央，一块风格化的雕花木牌上，优雅地以精致衬线字体展示着标题“A SPIRITUAL JOURNEY OF HAJJ”。周围的画框融入了繁复的伊斯兰阿拉伯式雕刻和悬垂的灯笼，统一了神圣的氛围，并借助层叠纸张工艺的深度与艺术性，将神圣的朝觐体验生动呈现。

A horizontal 16:9 poster for an offline plant swap event in Changsha, themed around the title text “长沙植物交换” and small subtitle “线下活动”. The visual is built as a calm, humid, graphic composition: the plant subject is reduced to a dark skeleton, negative voids and fragmented recognizable edges, as if compressed and developed from inside a large high-key visual field rather than placed in front of it. The subject is wrapped by a transparent, wet medium, partially occluded and refracted, so its contour becomes slightly discontinuous, bent, floating, and swallowed. The design follows one strong vertical axis crossing the wide frame, with the densest recognition core in the middle, while lower parts and side edges are cropped off by the frame to suggest an extension beyond the picture. Background is not decorative texture but a visible medium layer derived from the subject, containing field disturbances at different scales, transparent overlays, surface refraction and low-noise traces; these disturbances sweep across the subject, typography and empty areas, making the whole image look as if seen through a moist transparent surface. A large high-key main color dominates, with few low-key structural dark colors, transparent light highlights and one tiny high-energy colored annotation near a single key information node; the annotation is strictly controlled in area, like a precise mark rather than decoration. Typography is restrained technical sans-serif, clear, small scale and wide letter-spacing — the Chinese characters “长沙植物交换” and “线下活动” behave like coordinates, year, index, border or label, lying in the same visual layer as the image and slightly pressed by the field, creating a horizontal measuring and low-voice commenting feeling. Overall finish resembles offset printing viewed through a wet transparent surface, with faint scan grain, thin creases, pale cyan-white highlights and softened dark edges. The result should be clear, restrained, moist, geometric, with the same visual logic of strong axis, low-detail subject, field engulfing, micro information and single-point annotation.

Thick-and-thin confident linework, rich painted shadows, hard dramatic lighting, glowing energy effects, and gold sparks. The entire frame is bathed in deep crimson light; the sky behind the figure is a storm of scarlet and black, with red lightning cracking through rolling dark clouds. An obsidian-black dragon looms in the upper background, its burning red eyes glowing through dark smoke. Crimson sky light rakes forward from behind the character, while warm gold front light creates hard-edged rim lighting—red from behind, gold from in front. The character is an East Asian anime female adult, Fitzpatrick I-II, pale porcelain skin, large dark brown eyes, high cheekbones, and soft rounded features. Anime rendering with clean linework and rich painted shadows at the jaw and neck. Her hair is extremely long, straight, very dark brown near black, falling far past the waist and streaming behind her in the wind. Curtain bangs are center-parted, wispy, framing both sides of the forehead and falling past the eyes; this fringe is her defining landmark and does not change. Glowing gold-white asterisk-shaped rune markings with fine radiating lines trace along her upper left arm. She sits on ancient cracked stone steps, body turned three-quarters toward the viewer, both knees drawn up, feet resting on the step below. Her right hand is raised to chest height, holding a small glass vial filled with luminous deep red liquid, fingers loosely curled around it. Her left arm rests across her knees. She is unhurried while the world burns behind her; she has seen this before, and the dragon does not concern her. Her eyes are directed toward the viewer, jaw level, lips at a natural resting line: the calm at the center of the storm. Costume: black lacquered form-fitted chest armor with crimson underlayer visible at all joints and edge seams, gold filigree at every border, dark red pauldron on the right shoulder, white armored cap with a small white bow accent at the center front on the left shoulder, multiple gold chains draping from the neckline at varied lengths and swaying in the wind, gold-pearl beaded necklace visible above, pearl bracelet on the left wrist, white gauntlet on the left forearm with a black band at the upper edge, and white fitted greaves with double black bands at the top. Background: ancient stone steps, cracked and overgrown; red storm sky; vast black-scaled dragon upper left with glowing red eyes; red lightning tearing through the upper frame; gold sparks and embers drifting through the air. The dragon's eye is the second focal point after the character's face. Non-negotiables: center-parted curtain bangs framing both sides of the forehead; extremely long straight dark hair streaming in the wind; deep crimson sky and dragon background; small white bow on the left shoulder armor; glowing red vial held in the right hand. Short or pulled-back hair with bangs not visible is wrong; neutral or non-crimson background is wrong.

一幅宽幅横向风景手绘插画，描绘日本京都的金阁寺，强调留白与安静构图。

画面采用暖米白色纸张背景，占据整幅画布的40%-50%，形成宽阔的留白边缘与呼吸感。

金阁寺略微偏离画面中心，作为沉静的视觉锚点，以简化的金阁层叠屋顶轮廓与池边水岸线来呈现，笔触松散而富有表现力。金阁不是通过精确描绘每一个建筑细节，而是用极简的节奏痕迹与抽象色块来暗示，色块以深蓝绿色、钴蓝色和森林绿色为主。

构图疏朗而不杂乱：只有少量精心安排的元素，包括2-3个极小的人物剪影，颜色为珊瑚红和芥末黄，正沿着庭园小径漫步；一座极简造型的小型石灯笼；两三棵翠绿色的松树；以及隐现的日本宝塔屋檐线条等文化建筑暗示。

大面积的暖色纸张背景保持完全未处理的状态，尤其在边缘和元素之间。

风格融合了二十世纪中叶旅行海报美学与当代日本编辑插画的特点：优雅、极简、温暖、有文化感，并带一点怀旧。

质感上呈现松散的手绘水粉与粉彩痕迹：干笔触、粉彩涂抹、蜡笔边缘、不平整的色块、不完美的手工边界，以及色块之间可见的留缝。

色彩层叠、干燥且有触感，采用克制的调色板：深蓝绿色、天蓝色、珊瑚红、三文鱼粉、芥末黄、赭石、赤陶土色，以及少量接近黑色的点缀；但用色非常节制，让每种颜色都能在纸张上自如呼吸。

整体氛围安静、开阔、放松、精致，像一张富有格调的京都文化明信片或手工艺术版画，适合高端生活方式商品。

金阁寺仍通过其本质特征保持辨识度——两层上层完全由金箔覆盖，顶端立着一只青铜凤凰——但画面保持轻盈、宁静、富有诗意，且柔和抽象。

有强烈的停顿感、呼吸感与精致的空寂感，自信地运用留白。

不要拥挤的构图，不要铺满整个画面的繁杂背景，不要照片写实，不要光泽的数字渲染，不要干净的矢量图，不要3D渲染，不要文字，不要标识，不要logo，不要任何可读文本。

Ultra-viral cinematic travel poster of Nagasaki, Japan, designed for Pinterest, Instagram, and luxury travel magazines. A breathtaking vintage-modern collage blending history, culture, architecture, nature, and innovation into one unforgettable masterpiece. At the center stands the magnificent Ōura Cathedral, illuminated by warm golden sunset light, positioned dramatically against a gigantic textured crimson-red rising sun inspired by the Japanese flag. Behind it, Nagasaki’s iconic hillside cityscape cascades down lush green slopes, filled with tightly packed traditional and modern homes overlooking the harbor. In the foreground, the vibrant Nagasaki Shinchi Chinatown gate glows with red lanterns and intricate architectural details. A classic green Nagasaki streetcar moves through rain-soaked streets reflecting golden city lights. Beside it, a sleek white Shinkansen bullet train speeds forward, symbolizing the meeting of tradition and modern technology. To the right, the famous stone bridges and lantern-lit canals of Nagasaki shimmer with reflections, creating a magical evening atmosphere. Elegant white origami cranes float through the sky, representing peace, hope, and remembrance. White lilies bloom prominently in the foreground, adding beauty, symbolism, and depth. The entire composition is framed by aged travel ephemera including vintage maps, passport stamps, navigation charts, handwritten journal notes, old postcards, tickets, and weathered paper textures. Japanese calligraphy reading “長崎” appears boldly at the top, accompanied by sophisticated typography: “NAGASAKI JAPAN” and the slogan “Where History Meets the Future”. Rich golden-hour lighting, cinematic atmosphere, ultra-detailed architecture, dramatic depth, glowing reflections, warm amber and crimson color palette, vintage travel poster aesthetics, luxury editorial design, hyper-realistic textures, layered collage composition, breathtaking storytelling, highly shareable Pinterest-worthy artwork, award-winning tourism campaign style, 8K ultra-detail, vertical poster format, masterpiece quality, stop-scrolling visual impact, travel inspiration aesthetic. Aspect Ratio: 3:4 vertical.

创作一幅精致的宽幅旅行海报插画，主题为威尼斯。核心理念：将城市描绘成一件宁静、优雅、高度风格化的柔和纸拼贴画，把城市最标志性的地标——圣马可广场上的圣马可钟楼（Saint Mark's Campanile）——和最易识别的交通工具——经典贡多拉——融合在同一和谐画面中。插画应具有高端博物馆级旅行海报、精致编辑排版画作、收藏级纪念品印刷品和手工纸质立体模型的感觉。风格：极简柔和纸拼贴插画、分层剪纸艺术、平面几何色块、干净剪影、微妙的3D纸浮雕、柔软触觉纸纹理、细腻的剪纸阴影、可见纸纹、哑光水粉海报质感；避免写实感、真实渲染、CGI、光泽材质或过度细节。构图：宽幅横向构图；大面积开阔天空约占画面的40%–50%；清晰的前景、中景、背景分层；均衡的留白；放松通透的构图；绝不拥挤。前景：以一条经典贡多拉作为主要前景主体，用优雅的剪纸造型简化但保持一眼可辨，约占构图25%–35%；其周围布置少量花坛、长椅、小行人、路灯、运河系泊木桩（bricole）等本地城市细节。中景：用简化方式表现威尼斯城市景象，包括一座里亚尔托风格拱桥剪影的低矮石桥、成排的威尼斯宫殿立面、带咖啡店遮阳伞的小广场、贡多拉停靠桩；形状保持简化和图形化。背景：用分层剪纸剪影表现主地标圣马可钟楼，并以圣马可大教堂穹顶、总督府和圣乔治·马焦雷岛作为次级地标；天际线逐渐淡入柔和大气层次，只使用简化但仍易辨认的地标形状。天空：大片宁静柔和天空，包含2–5朵简洁纸云、几只小型纸鸟，留出充足呼吸空间，绝不过于繁复。配色：柔和天蓝、暖奶油色、浅米色、淡石灰、灰调鼠尾草绿、粉调薄荷、灰珊瑚色、柔桃色、米白，外加一个威尼斯特有的强调色：金色琥珀色。光照与氛围：明亮柔和的晨光、温和的环境光、柔和阴影、干净氛围、温暖乐观的情绪。排版：左上角放置城市名 VENICE；其下方一行文字 'Venezia · Venice'（当地语言名 · 英语名）；再下方小字副标题 'City of Canals'。使用白色几何无衬线字体，宽字距，简洁优雅。氛围：梦幻、值得收藏、有文化感、乐观、安静优雅、旅行启发、现代、奇想、精致。最终成果：一幅精致的威尼斯柔和纸拼贴城市海报，以经典贡多拉和圣马可钟楼作为两大视觉锚点，使用纸感纹理、干净的几何层次、充裕留白以及现代高端旅行插画美学。

一幅梦幻粉彩奇幻风景画，采用竖构图，画面中一座发光的东亚宝塔式寺庙半悬于高耸的结晶冰山群之间，四周环绕着娇嫩的粉色樱花树与飘散的花瓣。场景以略带低角度的正面广角环境镜头呈现，构图居中，寺庙略偏右，左上角伸入一簇花枝，前景层叠着光滑的岩石形态、发光的层叠瀑布，以及带有柔和粉光痕迹的镜面水池；视角接近35mm镜头效果，拥有深焦与柔和的大气景深，而非强烈虚化。以高度精修的3D奇幻插画风格呈现，表面极其光滑，岩石为雕刻般的哑光质感，冰峰半透明，并带有细微的体积雾气，结合空灵的霓虹辉光与洁净近乎瓷器的质感。光线柔和漫射，如同阴天暮色，冷青色蓝光从山脉与瀑布中散发出来，与寺庙窗户与点缀处的暖粉、蜜桃色光照形成对比，营造出宁静的生物荧光观感，附有柔和泛光与微弱边缘光。色彩以淡冰蓝、薰衣草灰、淡粉与珍珠白为主，低对比度、高柔和度，充满宁静奇幻情绪；背景极简并薄雾笼罩，看不到地平线，使山体仿佛孤悬于一片宁静的梦境世界。细节包括多层寺庙建筑与发光轮廓、风格化的阶梯与石基、扎根于岩石台地的多棵樱花树、丝绸般的水流动态、细小的飘浮花瓣，以及水中的细腻倒影。最终图像应给人纯净、电影般的感受，无颗粒感、无生硬阴影、泛光极轻、后期柔和，并呈现出 luminous 粉彩奇幻美学，堪比高端概念艺术或高级CG环境设计。

A vertical 3:4 high-resolution commercial advertising poster, single image only, no collage or multi-frame. The theme is a new product launch campaign for a smart running shoe. Overall style is a product-campaign giant-text-perspective poster, like a real brand campaign key visual, with commercial advertising sense, strong typographic design, youthful, product-launch energy, and visual impact. Core visual: the main subject is the sneaker, which must be clear, refined, and appear as a hero product in the ad. Include one professional runner captured mid-stride with a natural, dynamic pose. The product and the person have a realistic spatial relationship. Giant perspectival typography: the headline 'UNLEASH THE SPEED' becomes the core visual skeleton, using oversized bold sans-serif letters occupying the main space. The letters are not just a flat title; they form the three-dimensional structure of the scene, acting as a background wall, ground, running track, inclined plane, motion trajectory, or futuristic installation. The person and the product exist inside this giant letter space, with realistic front-back layering, occlusion, contact shadows, and perspective depth. Formal poster information system: near the top, place the brand name 'AEROS' and the small text 'NEW RELEASE / PRODUCT CAMPAIGN'. On the side, add vertical small text with collection number 'COLLECTION 01' and model/campaign number 'MODEL #DRIFT-X1'. Near the product, add four feature tags: '澎湃回弹', '碳板推进', '轻量透气', '智能芯片'. At the bottom, include a formal advertising information bar containing the product name, slogan, release date, key specifications, small credits, thin dividing lines, and decorative barcode/number. Typesetting should be refined, restrained, and reminiscent of a real brand guideline. Small text can function as decorative micro-typography; not every small character needs to be fully readable, but the brand name, product name, and headline must be clear. Image quality: sharp high-resolution commercial photography, realistic materials, accurate perspective, clear product, natural-looking person, and unified lighting. The whole image should feel like a genuine released product campaign poster. Avoid: no collage, no multi-image combination, no real logo, no cheap e-commerce look, no ordinary stock photo, no complex messy background, no cartoonish feel, product not too small, and the headline must not become a flat ordinary title.

Design language: premium editorial infographic, Apple UI × National Geographic food science, extremely clean, structured, and modern. A cheerful, creative composition blending a realistic subject with playful hand-drawn doodles and a subtle micro-story. Subject: a warm cup of coffee on a saucer with gentle steam rising. Mood: cozy and joyful morning. Layout uses an invisible clean grid, balanced airy spacing, and a clear hierarchy: the coffee cup is the focus, doodles are secondary, and micro details are tertiary. Doodles are playful, expressive, slightly exaggerated hand-drawn smiley faces, stars, sparkles, arrows, motion lines, and cute icons. They interact with the subject: small doodle hands touch the cup, a doodle arrow points to the steam, a star sparkles above the cup, and motion lines flow from the rising steam. A recurring main doodle character—a small round smiling blob with stubby arms—peeks from behind the cup and waves. A couple of tiny doodle characters skate on the saucer and another rides the swirl of steam. The micro story is subtle and discoverable on second glance: the doodle characters are giving the coffee a cheerful morning greeting. Typography: friendly sans-serif with handwritten notes like "good morning" and "hot!", casual and warm, not corporate. Color: white and soft cream base, soft black and dark grey ink, with cheerful accents of yellow, sky blue, and mint. Lighting: bright, soft, uplifting, with no harsh shadows. Style: clean, playful, slightly imperfect, human, warm, and creative. Constraints: no overcrowding, every doodle has a purpose or interaction, the subject stays clearly visible and unobstructed, and breathing space is maintained throughout.

制作一张时髦的每周穿搭指南海报，采用温暖的剪贴簿式编辑排版。主体画面中，以贝拉·哈迪德为模特，绘制一幅大型居中全身手绘时尚插画，周围环绕七个较小画板，分别对应周一至周日。插画风格为手绘时尚插画，融合东亚生活杂志美学，背景是有纹理的米白仿羊皮纸，包含植物素描、爱心涂鸦、胶带贴纸图形，以及咖啡杯、书本、自行车、相机和盆栽植物的线条画点缀。配色采用大地中性色：米色、奶油色、橄榄绿、藏青、浅蓝、棕色和灰色，整体氛围是Clean Girl、静奢风、极简学院风。穿搭内容：中央主造型为白色衬衫、米色阔腿裤、棕色腰带、棕褐色托特包和白色运动鞋。周一：米色开衫、白T恤、橄榄绿长裤。周二：黑白条纹上衣、白色长裤。周三：浅蓝色衬衫、蓝色牛仔裤。周四：藏青色衬衫连衣裙。周五：米色西装外套、白色上衣、棕色阔腿裤。周六：蓝色衬衫、白色长裤、灰色毛衣披在肩上。周日：灰色长风衣、白T恤、橄榄绿长裤。画面中需包含手写中文标题「徐薪雅 一週穿搭提案」，并在底部有一张用胶带贴住的小纸条，手写文字为“Elegance is refusal.”。整体呈现温馨、优雅、整齐的穿搭灵感板质感，高级编辑品质，柔和暖色调，细节丰富。
